result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clear layout defect in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where the middle card is vertically misaligned relative to its neighbors.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is shifted down by roughly 25–30px compared to the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccolo' cards. Its image top, delivery-time badge, title, and '€2.40 delivery' text all sit lower than the neighboring cards, breaking the row's baseline alignment.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all carousel items share the same top alignment (e.g., align-items: flex-start with consistent card height/margins) and remove any stray top margin/padding on the burgers card so its image and text line up with the other cards.
